findings.note: NHL Gamecenter lists Ottawa at 3.21 goals for and 2.92 against per game and Florida at 3.17 for and 2.96 against, which together are above 5.5. It also shows Florida's 23.4% power play (12th) facing Ottawa's 76.2% penalty kill (19th).

A Covers writer picks Florida on the moneyline and expects a low-scoring win. The same piece says Barkov and Marchand (both knee) could return, and that Ullmark (.935 SV% over five straight wins) may be due to regress, both of which could add goals.

Covers trend notes say the Under is 5-0-1 in Ottawa's last six road games against strong home teams and 4-0 in its last four games as an underdog. It lists the total at U5.5 (-105), and these are past-results trends, not proof of an edge.
